# Correct Gloda query-helper check ordering description

The helper checks membership for each visited returned item and calls query.test after the earlier checks succeed. It checks ordering only when orderVerifier is supplied.

This corrects the phrase "optional predicate checking" in the manual-style assessment for history entry1595. Unexpected membership or an order-verifier exception returns before the query predicate check. The original source quotation and behavior observation were accurate.

Scope: [GlodaQueryHelper.sys.mjs, lines80–151](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d/mailnews/db/gloda/test/unit/resources/GlodaQueryHelper.sys.mjs#L80-L151) at revision 0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, blob 8f9d97bedab838ef2514ee722d62aab5dc253a1e. This is a source-inspection correction. It adds no completed audit, runtime result or global style rule. Original evidence remains available.
